frozen.question: What do iPhone XR reviewers say about battery life?

chunks.text: 100% Battery Life!!!. I wanted to do this review to help others who may be considering. I don’t usually do reviews but I received a phone that looks to be brand new! My battery life was at 100%! I was so shocked when I seen this because I was expecting atleast a phone with a 90 or lower percent. I almost didn’t buy because I always read one star reviews just to see if everyone has the same complaint but I’m so glad I looked past those and just bought it.
Review. The phone works very well, no scratches or faults. The only thing I’d say bad about it was the battery life was low but it was still above 85% so that was okay

Battery Life. I realize that the description says 80% minimum battery life, but come on. My old XR phone (same model as one purchased) had more battery maximum capacity life and it's been in heavy daily use for 4 years. And I didn't get a SIM removal tool either. Luckily I had an extra.

Worst battery life. I know it's a cheap iphone, but it would be better if in the description it says the battery life before people buy it, because my iPhone came with 82% o bl, apple says under 80% battery will have problems, I was looking about some 89% or 90% bl

*** UPDATED REVIEW 04/25/20 ***. *** It’s only been about 4 weeks since we bought this and the phone is giving us trouble in regards to battery life and overheating really bad. Fiancé has the same model as me but his battery dies faster than mine ... even though I use my phone more. At first we were happy with the product but now we are highly disappointed. {Updated Review} ***
Battery life. It was a really good product. Loved the camera quality and the newness it had to it but the battery life was really a turn off. It had a 75% battery life
Battery life. The battery life isn’t as good as it could be but, the battery health was only 88% when I got it. Other then that it’s perfect
Battery life. Battery life- battery needs charging more often then it should
the health of the battery life. the battery life came at 86% and hence the life of the battery isn't good at all it runs down so fast
Battery life. Battery life is really bad...

sentences.text: One reviewer was pleased that the phone arrived with battery life at 100%.
Another reviewer said the battery life was low but still above 85%, which they found acceptable.
A reviewer complained that their phone's battery capacity was lower than their old XR that had been in heavy daily use for four years.
One reviewer called it the worst battery life and said their phone came with 82% battery health.
A reviewer reported battery life and overheating problems about four weeks after purchase.
Other reviewers described the battery as a turn-off at 75%, as needing charging more often than it should, and as running down very fast at 86% health.
